32: export function placeOrder () {
33:   return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
34:     const id = req.params.id
35:     BasketModel.findOne({ where: { id }, include: [{ model: ProductModel, paranoid: false, as: 'Products' }] })
36:       .then(async (basket: BasketModel | null) => {
37:         if (basket != null) {
38:           const customer = security.authenticatedUsers.from(req)
39:           const email = customer ? customer.data ? customer.data.email : '' : ''
40:           const orderId = security.hash(email).slice(0, 4) + '-' + utils.randomHexString(16)
41:           const pdfFile = `order_${orderId}.pdf`
42:           const { default: PDFDocument } = await import('pdfkit')
43:           const doc = new PDFDocument()
44:           const date = new Date().toJSON().slice(0, 10)
45:           const fileWriter = doc.pipe(fs.createWriteStream(path.join('ftp/', pdfFile)))
46: 
47:           fileWriter.on('finish', () => {
48:             void (async () => {
49:               try {
50:                 void basket.update({ coupon: null })
51:                 await BasketItemModel.destroy({ where: { BasketId: id } })
52:                 res.json({ orderConfirmation: orderId })
53:               } catch (error: unknown) {
54:                 next(error)
55:               }
56:             })()
57:           })
58: 
59:           doc.font('Times-Roman').fontSize(40).text(config.get<string>('application.name'), { align: 'center' })
60:           doc.moveTo(70, 115).lineTo(540, 115).stroke()
61:           doc.moveTo(70, 120).lineTo(540, 120).stroke()
62:           doc.fontSize(20).moveDown()
63:           doc.font('Times-Roman').fontSize(20).text(req.__('Order Confirmation'), { align: 'center' })
64:           doc.fontSize(20).moveDown()
65:           doc.font('Times-Roman').fontSize(15).text(`${req.__('Customer')}: ${email}`, { align: 'left' })
66:           doc.font('Times-Roman').fontSize(15).text(`${req.__('Order')} #: ${orderId}`, { align: 'left' })
67:           doc.moveDown()
68:           doc.font('Times-Roman').fontSize(15).text(`${req.__('Date')}: ${date}`, { align: 'left' })
69:           doc.moveDown()
70:           doc.moveDown()
71:           let totalPrice = 0
72:           const basketProducts: Product[] = []
73:           let totalPoints = 0
74:           for (const { BasketItem, price, deluxePrice, name, id } of basket.Products ?? []) {
75:             if (BasketItem != null) {
76:               challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.christmasSpecialChallenge, () => { return BasketItem.ProductId === products.christmasSpecial.id })
77:               try {
78:                 const quantityRow = await QuantityModel.findOne({ where: { ProductId: BasketItem.ProductId } })
79:                 if (quantityRow) {
80:                   const newQuantity = quantityRow.quantity - BasketItem.quantity
81:                   await QuantityModel.update({ quantity: newQuantity }, { where: { ProductId: BasketItem.ProductId } })
82:                 }
83:               } catch (error: unknown) {
84:                 next(error)
85:                 return
86:               }
87:               let itemPrice: number
88:               if (security.isDeluxe(req)) {
89:                 itemPrice = deluxePrice
90:               } else {
91:                 itemPrice = price
92:               }
93:               const itemTotal = itemPrice * BasketItem.quantity
94:               const itemBonus = Math.round(itemPrice / 10) * BasketItem.quantity
95:               const product = {
96:                 quantity: BasketItem.quantity,
97:                 id,
98:                 name: req.__(name),
99:                 price: itemPrice,
100:                 total: itemTotal,
101:                 bonus: itemBonus
102:               }
103:               basketProducts.push(product)
104:               doc.text(`${BasketItem.quantity}x ${req.__(name)} ${req.__('ea.')} ${itemPrice} = ${itemTotal}¤`)
105:               doc.moveDown()
106:               totalPrice += itemTotal
107:               totalPoints += itemBonus
108:             }
109:           }
110:           doc.moveDown()
111:           const discount = calculateApplicableDiscount(basket, req) ?? 0
112:           let discountAmount = '0'
113:           if (discount > 0) {
114:             discountAmount = (totalPrice * (discount / 100)).toFixed(2)
115:             doc.text(discount + '% discount from coupon: -' + discountAmount + '¤')
116:             doc.moveDown()
117:             totalPrice -= parseFloat(discountAmount)
118:           }
119:           const deliveryMethod = {
120:             deluxePrice: 0,
121:             price: 0,
122:             eta: 5
123:           }
124:           if (req.body.orderDetails?.deliveryMethodId) {
125:             const deliveryMethodFromModel = await DeliveryModel.findOne({ where: { id: req.body.orderDetails.deliveryMethodId } })
126:             if (deliveryMethodFromModel != null) {
127:               deliveryMethod.deluxePrice = deliveryMethodFromModel.deluxePrice
128:               deliveryMethod.price = deliveryMethodFromModel.price
129:               deliveryMethod.eta = deliveryMethodFromModel.eta
130:             }
131:           }
132:           const deliveryAmount = security.isDeluxe(req) ? deliveryMethod.deluxePrice : deliveryMethod.price
133:           totalPrice += deliveryAmount
134:           doc.text(`${req.__('Delivery Price')}: ${deliveryAmount.toFixed(2)}¤`)
135:           doc.moveDown()
136:           doc.font('Helvetica-Bold').fontSize(20).text(`${req.__('Total Price')}: ${totalPrice.toFixed(2)}¤`)
137:           doc.moveDown()
138:           doc.font('Helvetica-Bold').fontSize(15).text(`${req.__('Bonus Points Earned')}: ${totalPoints}`)
139:           doc.font('Times-Roman').fontSize(15).text(`(${req.__('The bonus points from this order will be added 1:1 to your wallet ¤-fund for future purchases!')}`)
140:           doc.moveDown()
141:           doc.moveDown()
142:           doc.font('Times-Roman').fontSize(15).text(req.__('Thank you for your order!'))
143: 
144:           challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.negativeOrderChallenge, () => { return totalPrice < 0 })
145: 
146:           if (req.body.UserId) {
147:             if (req.body.orderDetails && req.body.orderDetails.paymentId === 'wallet') {
148:               const wallet = await WalletModel.findOne({ where: { UserId: req.body.UserId } })
149:               if ((wallet != null) && wallet.balance >= totalPrice) {
150:                 await WalletModel.decrement({ balance: totalPrice }, { where: { UserId: req.body.UserId } })
151:               } else {
152:                 next(new Error('Insufficient wallet balance.'))

158:             } catch (error: unknown) {
159:               next(error)
160:               return
161:             }
162:           }
